reviews.rationale: Sequential GAAP revenue growth was broad-based across the two larger revenue components, with the smaller hardware and professional services component declining. Gross profit rose alongside revenue, but total costs of revenue and total operating expenses also rose, so operating income advanced only modestly and the sequential improvement in GAAP profitability was largely carried by items below the operating line, including a favorable swing in the warrant fair value change and higher net interest income. The increase in the signed income tax line is a larger tax charge, not a smaller tax drag, and it partly offsets the pretax improvement. Company-reported gross payment volume rose, consistent with a larger processed volume base, but the selected rows do not establish that volume drove revenue or margin. All comparisons are sequential displayed-value arithmetic on selected exhibit rows, not year-over-year, not non-GAAP, and not guidance; no causal attribution is asserted. The thesis remains active at unchanged conviction because the selected evidence is directionally consistent with the stored baseline and contains no invalidation trigger, but the extract lacks segment-level cost detail, non-GAAP reconciliations, guidance, and any year-over-year context needed to judge durability.
